scope: Known independent comparison failures of direct native SELECT projections in the shared join runner. Require an unchanged direct oracle request, a resolved independent source or closed join source, and no DISTINCT, result ordering, bounds or bound parameters. Require at least two explicitly labelled output positions.
original: Write the original input, comparison failure, case identifier, attempted batch and execution accounting before any reduction. Keep that artifact unchanged.
proposals: Remove one output position at a time in original position order. Keep the original input sources, filter, remaining operand identities and labels. Only consider strictly smaller requests.
confirmation: Reconstruct through the normal direct constructor and confirm all original oracle premises. Independently observe SQL on the same fixture. Repeat the original failure once. A candidate must reproduce the same metadata, row or combined comparison failure twice, with the same exact response per replay.
time: Use the original worker and observer deadlines. A transport, construction, infrastructure or timeout failure does not count as a reduction.
retention: Record all classifications in a separate artifact linked to the original by digest. A reducer failure or unmet premise cannot remove or replace the original counterexample. Negative inputs, analyzed SQL and unclassified observations keep their original request.
controls: An invalid construction or failed fixture premise
Bounded proposals and explicit rejection of ineligible cases
